_note: Intro Nokon curtain layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. COLOR colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255; SetColor colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1; the ink gradient colours are #RRGGBB text markup; opacities 0 to 1.

title._note: the name, letter by letter: tracking_em between letters and space_em for a space, in font sizes; a line wider than max_width shrinks to it; y is the middle of the lines, line_gap between their centres; text_nudge moves the text inside its glyph box

lights._note: texture_size is Spot.png's size; the two spots circle in on an orbit of orbit_x by orbit_y around the screen's centre; the merged spot the name stands in sits under the title

confetti._note: count pieces, starting start_y to start_y - spread_y above the screen, at a scale of scale_min to scale_min + scale_extra; a flipping piece is never thinner than min_flip; a piece more than cull_margin off the screen is not drawn
